header.title: Muse generic coding-harness ontology
header.description: Reusable coding-harness run/workspace/repository/event-log/tool/build/test/retry concepts independent of Artist.

definition.text: A tool invocation used to delegate, message, poll, abort, list, or hand off agent work.
A tool invocation that creates, opens, or manipulates a harness-managed application surface.
A concrete build activity/process execution performed within a coding harness.
A tool invocation explicitly structured as a software build operation.
A tool invocation that inspects source-code structure, symbols, dependencies, calls, or related indexed code information.
A tool invocation that performs a structured source-code transformation.
A software agent operating in a coding harness to perform software-engineering tasks.
A software system that orchestrates coding-agent runs, model turns, tools, workspaces, and run/event records.
An agent run scoped to a coding-harness execution episode and its run identity.
An agent task whose subject matter is software engineering or modification of a software workspace.
A failure outcome reported for a shell/command invocation.
A concrete compilation activity/process execution performed within a coding harness.
A tool invocation explicitly structured as compilation.
A tool invocation that observes or acts on a computer surface through a structured interface.
An information artifact/identity that designates one ordered conversational branch through a coding-harness session and can persist across multiple model runs.
An information artifact containing ordered structured records for coding-harness occurrences and content.
A structured information artifact recording one harness occurrence, state update, message, tool invocation/result, or other logged datum.
A tool invocation directed to a service outside the local harness process/workspace boundary.
A tool invocation whose structured operation addresses filesystem paths or filesystem information.
A software artifact created as an output of coding-agent/tool activity.
A temporally bounded harness context that groups one or more coding runs, conversation lineages, tool activity, and its event-log identity without identifying the session with any single run.
A tool invocation that reads or changes durable agent memory through a structured harness interface.
A tool invocation explicitly structured as a model/inference operation.
A tool invocation explicitly structured as network or remote-service interaction.
A filesystem/software-development action that attempts to apply a patch artifact to workspace artifacts.
An information artifact specifying a set of intended textual/source changes.
A tool invocation whose structured operation applies or constructs a patch.
An action intended to restore progress or usable state after a failed/partial coding-harness occurrence.
A software artifact collection managed under a repository identity, potentially with version-control history.
A tool invocation that retrieves harness resources such as skills or other registered informational resources.
An action that repeats or re-attempts a prior invocation/run step after failure, interruption, or another retry condition.
An event-log record identifying creation, status, usage, or completion information for a coding run.
A command invocation executed through a shell/process tool in a coding harness.
A tool invocation whose structured operation is shell/process execution or session management.
A file artifact that bears source-code information content.
A tool invocation that reads or changes harness-owned task/todo state.
A concrete testing activity/process execution performed within a coding harness.
A tool invocation explicitly structured as test execution.
A structured event-log/message record that identifies a tool invocation and its arguments, distinct from the invocation occurrence itself.
A failure outcome reported for a coding-harness tool invocation.
A structured event-log record that records result/error content for a tool invocation, distinct from independently observed world effects.
An event-log record representing a user/agent conversational turn or model turn.
A tool invocation that explicitly requests or records interaction with the attached human user.
An execution environment containing the filesystem/repository state made available for a coding run.

harness:eventSequence.definition: Relates a coding-harness event to the exact source-log sequence number represented as an integer data value.

harness:generatedByRun.definition: Relates a generated coding artifact to the coding run during which it was generated.

harness:logRecords.definition: Relates a coding event log to a record contained in that log.

harness:occursInWorkspace.definition: Relates a coding-harness event to the workspace that provides the local execution/filesystem context for that event.

harness:patchUsesArtifact.definition: Relates a patch application to the patch artifact it attempts to apply.

harness:recordBelongsToRun.definition: Relates a structured harness record to the coding run identity whose occurrence/content it records.

harness:recoversFromEvent.definition: Relates a recovery action to an event whose failure, interruption, or partial completion motivated recovery.

harness:recoversFromOutcome.definition: Relates a recovery action to a reported execution outcome that motivated recovery.

harness:retryOf.definition: Relates a retry action to the prior occurrence/invocation/run step being re-attempted.

harness:runInHarness.definition: Relates a coding run to the coding harness orchestrating it.

harness:runInLineage.definition: Relates a coding run to the conversation lineage under which that run contributes model/tool activity.

harness:runWorkspace.definition: Relates a coding run to the workspace against which it operates.

harness:sessionHasLineage.definition: Relates a harness session to a conversational lineage identified within that session.

harness:sessionHasRun.definition: Relates a harness session to a coding run grouped within that session.

harness:sessionInHarness.definition: Relates a harness session to the coding harness orchestrating that session.

harness:toolCallRecordsInvocation.definition: Relates a tool-call record to the tool-invocation occurrence it denotes/records.

harness:toolResultCarriesResult.definition: Relates a tool-result record to the tool-result information artifact it carries.

harness:toolResultRecordsInvocation.definition: Relates a tool-result record to the tool invocation whose result/error it reports.

harness:workspaceRepository.definition: Relates a coding workspace to a repository represented within it.
